svg.aria-label: HeartGuard AI, a machine learning system for cardiovascular risk assessment on the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Patient features, 303 records by 13 clinical features, pass through SMOTE resampling and stratified cross-validation, feature selection with recursive feature elimination and PCA, into four compared models: Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM and Logistic Regression. Random Forest leads with 85.2 percent accuracy, 0.847 F1 and 0.901 ROC-AUC. Top predictive features are chest pain type, maximum heart rate, ST depression, major vessel count and thalassemia type.
